title: Shinonome Akito — Those Wild Cheers〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That okonomiyaki was so good!
But Akito's sister ended up paying for everything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I sort of feel guilty about having her buy our share.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, please tell your sister later how much we appreciate her gesture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure thing.
I'll tell her when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, weren't we supposed to buy food for Len and the others?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
What should we get? More okonomiyaki?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
More?
Hang on. Shouldn't we just ask what they want?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, let's do that!
Lemme just tell them what's up and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys rang?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we were just about to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Check out all the stalls, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wow! This is what you were talking about! I've been wanting to see for myself ever since you told us that story about the Summer Festival, Len!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, same!
That's like the only thing you've been talking about lately!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Th-That's not true!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha! But you were right, Len. Just look at all these stalls. It looks like so much fun that I don't know where to begin.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Keep it down, you guys. We wouldn't want anybody seeing you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<We know!
This isn't my first time, so I'll be...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, that man's holding a big ear of corn! Can we go see that?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, that must be a stall for roasted corn. The sizzling soy sauce looks very appetizing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, the girl in white over there is holding some adorable-looking balls. What are those?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's called baby castella.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I'm interested in that red place!
The one behind Toya...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The takoyaki stall? I'm interested as well actually...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really? I wanna see what all those people are doing over there!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What are they selling?
I can't really see. There's too many people... It looks like... Shaved ice?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, settle down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm glad that they're enjoying everything so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, going around to each place they want to see will require quite a bit of time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's split up to buy everything.
We can meet back up once we're all done.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay! Luka, you come with me.
I've been meaning to check out the baby castella stand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, really? Thank you, An. Let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO, you can come with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Great! Lead the way, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Who are you taking, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um, I'll take...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I don't have any strong preferences...
But I wanna say that the roasted corn stall's pretty far from here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll take Len.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, Rin, let's get some shaved ice together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Cool! Thanks, Kohane!
Let's go! It's that way!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, alright.
Hey, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's Shota!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, wait, hide...!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Thank goodness I found you.
I thought you'd gone home already.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was actually about to, but decided to check out some of the stalls before I did. Anyway, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: It's not super important, but I thought that I should thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I really appreciate you and your team participating in this event. You guys really made the whole place go wild!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's no big.
If anything, thanks for inviting us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This ended up being a good experience for us, I mean, it's not every day that you get to perform on such a big stage.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Right. Then, I'm glad I invited you guys!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
I'll see you around, Akito!
Again, thanks for the awesome performance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hmm... Interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I pretty much stopped talking to Shota after I quit playing soccer. But now, we're back to seeing each other kinda often...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Shota!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... If you end up working on another event, make sure to let us know, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Does that mean you'll perform in the next one...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'll depend on the situation, but we're friends, right? I might be willing to lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thanks! I'll keep that offer in mind!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. Anyway, see you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you smiling about?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, nothing...
Anyway, let's hurry up and get us some roasted corn!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine...
